method: Use the six actual detector cells from the pinned dark receipt. Map common-grid cell centers to native stereo-green centroids with explicit half-pixel offset, then use the frozen quadratic tangent solution. Use the official smoothed continuum-subtracted FITS for tiles 153 and 119. Compute median and range inside fixed angular apertures and retain signed signal; reject incomplete supports below 90 percent. Compare signed and centered differences for the same covered cells when both tiles pass. This measures independent H-alpha sky structure, not contemporaneous broadband optical background or conversion to M8/M20 ADU.
